name: charly-fireactions
description: Fireactions — GitHub Actions runners on Firecracker microVMs: the pool model where a runner is a microVM, the containerd snapshotter constraint that decides whether a pool needs a spare block device, the opencharly fork and why it is pinned, the host layer that installs the VMM and kernel, and the beds that gate the host and the runner.
